{"sourceType":"ESA Tender Action","sourceSystem":"ESA esa-star Publication","sourcePage":"https://esastar-publication-ext.sso.esa.int/ESATenderActions/filter/open","id":139343,"idEra":21677,"activityNumber":"1000042051","contractNumber":"","tanumber":"1-12607","title":"TECHNOLOGIES TO ACCURATELY ESTIMATE THE BATTERY STATE OF CHARGE - EXPRO PLUS","description":"Some new Li-Ion batteries have a very flat IV (current-voltage) curve. Thus, as they are discharged the voltage stays very flat. The classical method to measure the state of charge (SoC) was simply to measure the voltage. However, this is more complicated now because there is not a big change in voltage. Therefore, it is not possible to accurately estimate the SoC. This has very critical system level implications.
